question: What condition affects even the wise one at the tip of nectar and essence?
premises: The location is the tip of nectar
The means involves the tip of essence
Even a wise person experiences burning
inference: Even the wise one experiences a burning sensation at the tip of nectar and essence.
uncertainties: The physiological referents of amṛta+agraṃ and rasa+agreṇa are symbolic.
plain_english: Even the wise one feels a burning at the tip of nectar, at the tip of essence.
